description: Find specific members by a name fragment, or list those holding a given role. For the whole roster use list_members; for one member's full profile use get_member; to turn a fuzzy name into an id use find. Name search uses Discord's member search; role filtering walks the member list and reports if it hit the paging cap.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

query.description: Name prefix to search for (username or nickname).

role.description: Role name or ID; returns members holding it.

name: search_members
title: Search members
